comment: P7-42 stage table. Stage names come from the ACTUAL chain read out of the
shipped binary's DWARF line table, not from an a-priori list.
Every range is a file:line window in this worktree at 0e4ee496, and every
stage is SYMBOL-SCOPED: shared inline helpers (Vm.next, byteCode(),
loadCurrentLevel, Stack.topPtr, JSValue.dup) occur in more than one of the
mapped symbols, so an unscoped file:line table leaks samples between the
driver-re-entry stage and the callback's own return handler.
S* = on the builtin->bytecode callback bridge.
C* = present on the direct-control path as well.
X* = legs this corpus never takes; their sample counts are the instrument's

popAndResume (tailcall_dispatch.zig:1069-1204) is inlined into BOTH op_return and op_return_undef; forEach's noop callback retires through op_return_undef while some/every/filter's predicate callbacks retire through op_return, so both symbols must be mapped or three of the four families lose their whole return column.

S7 is split into five sub-stages so the report can separate work that is re-derived from state the push path already held (S7c/S7d) from the cost of the driver activation itself (S7b) and from the dispatch entry (S7e). The split is by file:line within the same three symbols; the sum of the five equals the single S7 bucket of the earlier run.

stages.name: S1_callsite_entry_and_poll
stages.what: noinline call-site prologue, one interrupt poll, active-invocation identity check, native-boundary-simple eligibility test

stages.name: S2_fence_scope_construct
stages.what: NativeBoundaryScope.init: capture the outer view, runtime pointer, MachineBacktraceView.segment over the current top, fence_depth snapshot

stages.name: S3_fence_publish
stages.what: NativeBoundaryScope.push: freeze the outer backtrace view, build the ActiveBacktraceFrame, link it into rt.hot.current_backtrace_frame, repoint invocation.current_backtrace_view

stages.name: S4_frame_admission
stages.what: planned stack bytes, runtime depth/byte budget commit, Entry slot lookup, VM stack arena carve

stages.name: S5_argument_staging
stages.what: carve the arg_count-wide parameter window, duplicate min(3, arity) callback arguments into it, clear the tail

stages.name: S6_entry_publication
stages.what: write the callback Entry: return_action=.native_boundary, catch target, profile guard, arena mark, complete Frame record, Stack arena window, teardown bits, prev link, depth bump

stages.name: S8_special_return
stages.what: return-handler special-return test, native-boundary arm, popReturnedNativeBoundary teardown, publish vm.return_value and the .native_returned outcome; op_return reaches the same arm through popAndResume's action switch

stages.name: S9_fence_restore
stages.what: NativeBoundaryScope.finish: unlink the ActiveBacktraceFrame, restore invocation.current_backtrace_view, re-liven the outer view

stages.name: S10_return_to_builtin
stages.what: hand the callback result back out of the noinline call site and restore the builtin's own register state

stages.name: X11a_fallback_args_hoisted
stages.what: argument loads for the never-taken authoritative fallback call, hoisted by the compiler into the unconditional prologue

stages.name: X11b_fallback_call_cold
stages.what: NOT TAKEN: the authoritative JS_Call-shaped fallback call itself

stages.name: X11c_owned_copy_leg
stages.what: NOT TAKEN: OwnedArgList leg for non-simple-eligible callees

stages.name: C90_leaf_return_arms
stages.what: shared with the direct control: op_return_undef zero-arg / exact-args leaf return arms and their inline epilogues

stages.name: S7a_fence_depth_check_and_driver_call
stages.what: runActiveInvocationUntilNativeBoundary: fence-depth check, the call into the driver, and the post-return depth/top asserts

stages.name: S7b_driver_frame_save_restore
stages.what: the runTC activation itself: callee-saved register save/restore for a frame that has the whole inlined run() live-range

stages.name: S7c_vm_cache_rebuild
stages.what: rebuild the Vm cache: Machine.loadCurrentLevel (depth branch, machine.top, &entry.frame/&entry.stack/&entry.catch_target), frame.function, function.byteCode(), then ten Vm field stores

stages.name: S7d_run_prologue
stages.what: run(): dispatch-table pointers, local_fast_blocked re-derivation, pc = code_base + frame.pc, sp = stack.topPtr(), var_buf = frame.locals.ptr

stages.name: S7e_dispatch_entry_and_outcome
stages.what: the call into next() and the run-loop outcome switch that turns .native_returned into the driver's return value
